integrity: The exact phase diagram is proved by complete rational comparison; independent checking has not been performed. Indexed-literature completeness is not guaranteed.
scientific_limitations: Unit-conductance unweighted simple complete bipartite graphs only; exactly three distinct noise-free leaders; uniform independent follower disturbances and inverse-grounded-Laplacian trace. No claim for variable leader count, weighted/directed graphs, other noise models or eigenvalue objectives.
title: Exact three-leader coherence allocation on complete bipartite networks
